name: ormma
description: Ormma monorepo root: shared tooling and scripts only. mobile/ and functions/ are independent projects.

scripts.emulators: npm run prereqs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-ormma --import=emulator-data --export-on-exit=emulator-data
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.test:fns: npm run prereqs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ormma "npm --prefix functions run test:fns:run"
scripts.test:rules: npm run prereqs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-ormma "npm --prefix functions run test:rules:run"
scripts.test:rules:mutations: npm run prereqs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-ormma "node scripts/mutation-check-rules.mjs"
